name: Attribution Reporting API on Android
plain: A built-in way for ad tech to count conversions with noise and limits, without ad IDs.
meaning: Event-level and summary reports with caps and delays; Google announced in Oct 2025 it would retire it while standards work continues at W3C.

android.store_policy: Privacy Sandbox status page lists as scheduled for phaseout (page updated Aug 2026)
android.note: Google announced on 17 Oct 2025 it is retiring this along with most Privacy Sandbox APIs. No Android removal date was stated in the announcement.

limits.headline: Can't count on this Android ad counting tool, since Google announced it is retiring it
limits.user_action: Nothing. It was a background feature, and Google announced its retirement on 17 Oct 2025
can: Have counted ad results with noise and limits, without ad IDs (Android 13 and later)
Have sent event level and summary reports
Keep working until Google sets a removal date
cannot: Run on iPhone; it is not an Apple feature
Count on it long term, since most of Privacy Sandbox is being retired
Show a removal date; none was named
limits.differs: Android only. iPhone never had it.

story.what_it_is: Google's built in way to count ad conversions with noise, instead of using an ad ID.

marketing.name: Privacy Sandbox on Android
marketing.pitch: Privacy preserving ad tools that limit cross app tracking. Google announced in October 2025 it would retire them.

story.for_you: You would not see it. It would have let advertisers learn that an ad led to a sale, with random noise and no ID.
story.for_makers: It offered event level and summary reports with caps and delays. Google announced the retirement in October 2025 while the same ideas continue as a web standard.

use_cases.example: An ad network measures how many installs a video ad produced without the advertising ID.
A game maker checks whether a banner drove paying players, with noisy counts.
A retailer gets a daily report of purchases per ad, and cannot see who bought.
A measurement firm tests summary reports against the old ID based totals.
Caps on data bits make it harder to track one person across apps.
A developer joins a beta to test the API and later must plan for its retirement.

story.android_note: Announced in October 2025 to be retired, and mostly not widely used.
story.ios_note: iOS uses SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit for the same job.

technical_bounds: Retired: do not build new features on this
Ad ID stays the main cross-app identifier

legit_uses: Was meant as an ID-free ad system

history.change: Retirement announced; interoperable standard continues at W3C PATWG
